name: get_service_status
description: Return the current health, replica count and region of a service in the fleet.

inputSchema.description: Which service to inspect, and in which environment.

service.description: Service name, one of: checkout, search, billing.

environment.description: Environment name: dev, staging or prod.

inputSchema.description: Which service to read metrics for, and over what window.

service.description: Service name, one of: checkout, search, billing.

environment.description: Environment name: dev, staging or prod.

inputSchema.description: Which service to restart, and in which environment.

service.description: Service name, one of: checkout, search, billing.

environment.description: Environment name: dev, staging or prod.

environment.description: Environment name: dev, staging or prod.
